A GUARDIAN’S GUIDE

Seven shrines. One sacred duty.

Stop the army before it reaches the temple. Tap a numbered plot, choose a deity, then begin the wave.

Offerings & favour

Offerings are the only currency. Spend them to establish a shrine or raise its divine favour: Established → Honoured → Exalted. Favour is a level, not a second balance. Rebuilding returns 85% of your investment.

Divine protection

A deity’s name above a foe marks their protection. That shrine will not harm them. Build a mixed defence and inspect the next wave before starting.

Useful combinations

Varuna + Indra: wet foes carry lightning.
Prithvi + Agni: hold foes in burning ground.
Vayu + Durga: push foes back to a guardian.
Saraswati: musical attacks, revelation and faster nearby shrines. Every deity deals damage.

Divine intervention

Defending fills one shared meter. At 100%, select an established shrine and call its intervention during a wave. Choose the deity carefully.

Waves and battles

A wave is a group of enemies. A battle is the full eight-wave defence of one temple. Shrines and upgrades stay between waves; a new battle starts afresh.

Extra offerings

Once all foes in a wave have arrived, call the next wave early for bonus offerings. Two waves overlap, so be ready for the extra pressure.

Restoration and lamps

Win to restore the temple. Earn three lamps for victory, an intact shield and the map’s challenge, across separate attempts. All three unlock festival decorations.

Follow the river

Travel with Mira from the banyan grove to the river’s source. Five chapters are open for testing; Continue upriver follows the story in order.

Pause to plan, build or upgrade. Choose 1×, 2× or 5× speed. Enemy introductions always pause combat. Progress saves on this browser; an interrupted battle resumes paused. All seven shrines and all five temples are available in this prototype. The powers and boons are fictional game interpretations.
